Government Unveils 'Saptadhara' Economic Strategy

The Indian government has announced a new economic strategy named 'Saptadhara', which translates to seven streams. This initiative aims to reform capital markets and stimulate growth. The strategy outlines seven distinct areas of focus for economic development. Specific details of the seven streams were not elaborated upon in the provided coverage.
